senses.definition: A member of a decision-making body (such as a committee) for a larger organization or entity (including some public agencies), similar to or equivalent to a board of directors (used especially for banks); a member of the board of governors.
examples: The seven members of the Board of Governors of the Federal Reserve System are nominated by the President and confirmed by the Senate.
